sourceText: write a letter to chief engineer incharge regarding non working of all three Airconditioner since start of the season at Delhi Government Health Centre - Homoeopathic unit. Explain how it is causing inconvinience to the patients and also as homoeopathic medicines are based on alcohol, the chance of evaporation of medicine with increase in temperature. Several requests made to the contractor followed with request to Junior Engineer resulted in no results. JE did sent one technician who visited the dispensary and made one of them in working condition only for one day. From next day they are not working again. Immediate attention is required in public interest

sourceText: Create academic notes on the subject Role of IS in business strategy suitable for university-level (MBA)  students. The content should be written in a formal and academic tone, but the language must remain clear, simplified, and easy to understand. Avoid technical jargon and explain complex terms using plain English. Organize the notes using clear headings and subheadings, and present key concepts through step-by-step explanations. Focus only on the most essential ideas necessary for understanding business strategy, and support each major concept with real-world, practical examples that show its application in modern business environments. The notes should be structured and formatted for readability, using bullet points where appropriate, and should be tailored for students who may not have a technical background.
